title: Choose the render target and image backend
body: What acre render writes: a directory of PNG frames, a video, or both, and which crate draws the pixels. Depends on the language only so far as the language fixes what shapes exist.
close_reason: PNG frame directory, tiny-skia + png, text via ttf-parser outlines, embedded font. Details in the note.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/89ec73b0
notes.text: Decided: acre render writes one PNG per frame into the output directory, named by zero-padded frame index. tiny-skia (0.12) rasterizes and png (0.18) encodes. Text goes through the same rasterizer: ttf-parser (0.25) gives glyph outlines, which become tiny-skia paths and are filled. One OFL font is embedded in the binary so output does not depend on the machine. No video output for now; ffmpeg over the frame directory covers it. Rejected: image (no anti-aliased vector paths), raqote (same niche, less maintained), skia-safe (C++ build), vello (GPU), SVG frames (kept as a possible second renderer).
